label: Profile source
description: Third-party profile or feature article that connects multiple chapters of the biography.

label: Collaboration / co-author announcement
description: Direct announcement marking a research collaboration, co-authorship, or institutional affiliation.

label: Publication proof
description: A peer-reviewed paper or conference abstract that establishes a publication record.

label: AI / research positioning
description: A source that frames the present research direction — explainable AI inside Noah-MP, HPC at scale, AI for Earth system science.

label: Primary announcement
description: A dated first-party or media release suitable for stronger editorial treatment because it is direct and specific.

label: Anchor publication
description: An early peer-reviewed or conference publication that anchors a chapter in the literature.

label: Geography proof
description: A source-backed artifact that turns location and institutional footprint into narrative evidence rather than decorative mapping.

label: Research ecosystem visibility
description: A grouped artifact for conference, allocation, and collaboration signals that keep the present-tense chapter grounded in dated sources.
